name: project-cmd-graph-records-includes-dirty-flag
body: graph_records renders every node property, so a row's session-only updated dirty flag is part of the compared record set, and the PendingRemoval ledger is skipped by table name. A database compared mid-session with an unsaved mutation would differ only by that flag. Upgrade — strip the updated column and revisit the ledger skip if session state ever enters the comparison.
